title: REQ · Boy sheet source holds 14 frames of 32x48 for idle, walk and interact
summary: Boy sheet grids: 4 idle, 6 walk, 4 interact frames at 32x48, palette-only
description: Context: no boy source exists in game/frontend/src/art. Desired behavior: boy.ts exports a pure BOY_SHEET_SOURCE with 14 frames built from draw.ts helpers with outline and ramp shading (blue hoodie). Expected result: frame count and size are testable. Why: SG-2.2 done-when.
acceptance_criteria: Given BOY_SHEET_SOURCE, when frames.length is read, then it equals 14
Given each frame, when height and width are read, then they are 48 and 32
Given every cell, when checked, then each value is an integer in 0..PALETTE.length-1
